snippet.title: SWORD ART ONLINE Alicization Lycoris - Blooming of Matricaria | Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
Get ready to battle for humanity's survival in Sword Art Online Alicization Lycoris DLC! 
Join Kirito and his new ally Rogu as they face off against Round Robin and the Four Lords in Blooming of Matricaria. 

New story, characters, weapons, and more await in this thrilling expansion, available now on Nintendo Switch. 
#SAOAL

Discover the game now:https://bnent.eu/SAOAL
